text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—The winner is Admire Vega. Having pushed 
each other to new heights alongside Narita 
Top Road, she was able to defeat the 
strongest Supreme Overlord.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It has been proven that T.M. Opera O is 
not invincible. Fired up, Narita Top Road 
becomes determined that she, too, can 
surely win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O was being cornered. Seeing 
this, Meisho Doto put a certain thought 
into action—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, having carved out her own future, 
Narita Top Road advances to the first race 
of the Autumn GⅠ campaign—the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!
